answer: Proof of Personhood via biometric attestation creates a zephyr of scarcity in an open digital meadow. By requiring agents to cryptographically bind their quill-signed transactions to unique biological entropy, the network forces an attacker to acquire expensive physical identities. This mechanism imposes a linear cost on Sybil creation, as the adversary must solve the difficult problem of synthesizing synthetic biometric data that satisfies the protocol’s rigorous, decentralized verification threshold.
